annotations.exact_quote: learning from both pairwise constraints and unlabeled data
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要表明结合成对约束与未标注数据进行学习，标题也明确为 semi-supervised classification，符合半监督设定。

annotations.exact_quote: Our approach can effectively propagate pairwise constraints to the whole data set.
annotations.reason_zh: 方法显式将 must-link/cannot-link 成对约束传播到整个数据集，符合成对约束传播的定义。

annotations.exact_quote: learn a mapping that is smooth over the data graph
annotations.reason_zh: 以数据图上的平滑性约束所学映射，属于图与流形正则化的几何一致性约束。

annotations.exact_quote: two must-link objects are mapped to the same point while two cannot-link objects are mapped to be orthogonal
annotations.reason_zh: 将 must-link 样本拉近到同一点、令 cannot-link 样本正交，体现样本间吸引与区分的表示学习目标。
